title: The estimate guesses wrong
notes: Three requests at 0, then two at 12 and one at 15. At 12 the counter still counts 0.8 of the 3 from [0, 10), so the second request at 12 sees 1 + 2.4 = 3.4 and is refused, though only one request came in (2, 12]. The estimate assumes the 3 were spread over their window; they all came at 0. The other three limiters let it through.
